sonnet.problem: The card drops Moses' "Do not" in verse 9. "Plant your vineyard with two types of seed, and he says the entire harvest will be defiled" reads as a command to plant two types of seed, which the text shows is wrong. The verse is a prohibition with a stated result, and the card does not tell it that way.
sonnet.rule: He never says anything the text shows is wrong.

sonnet.problem: Verse 5 is never set up on a story card. The true/false statement is simply the verse itself, and nothing earlier lets the baker reason that it is true, so a True pick can only be luck.
sonnet.rule: Before each choice card, Papa Dorin's story card gives enough context that the baker can reason their way to the answer.

sonnet.problem: The choice card asks about the second half of verse 26 ("just like one in which a man attacks his neighbor and murders him"). The story card that tells the first half of verse 26 ("Do nothing to the young woman...") comes after it, so the choice card jumps ahead of the text.
sonnet.rule: Cards follow the passage in order. A choice card can look back at a verse an earlier card in the same stop told, but never jumps ahead.
